instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put on a vest like yours. Yes, I'll help clean the hall; high-visibility volunteers supervise, don't they?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's cycling gear. The hall rule is that everyone takes a turn with the mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, a turn. I'll take the final inspection turn, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you to mop while I put away the tables.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly—my turn includes signing off the floor. I'll decide when we can leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I raised my hand when you did. Yes, I'll host Christmas; that vote puts me in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking for more tea. We agreed everyone supplies one dish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, contributions. Hosting counts as mine, so I don't owe a dish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cook the turkey at yours, but you'll need to clear the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear it, then. But that's hosting; don't count me twice and put me on peeling as well.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I knocked the teapot twice like you. Now there's tea on the table; we need a rule about tapping.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was tapping the lid loose. You hit the spout.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why we need approved tapping points. I'll mark the lid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please just use a cloth. The tea's reaching my papers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cloth first, then. From now on, no papers within a teapot's reach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I shut one eye like you. Half my face is asleep in the family photo. We need a signal for eyes open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had one eye against the viewfinder. Everyone in the picture needs both open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll appoint someone to check both eyes before you press the button.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can already see everyone's eyes through the camera.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Say 'both eyes checked' before each picture. We'll wait for the announcement.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've wrapped my fingers in tape like yours. Lend me your racket; I'd like a fair shot at winning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are taped because they're sprained. You need your fingers loose to hold a racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, tape off for the match. Can I borrow your racket now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can borrow it. If you win, tell the club whose racket it is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll thank you for the loan before we start. Afterward, let me talk about how I played.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I pressed zero like you did. Stay for my pumpkin's weight; we're settling our competition today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was an empty basket. You've zeroed the scales with your pumpkin on them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, starting level. Stay while I lift it off and put it back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reset it while it's empty. I've got to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reset it with me before you go, then stay for the weight. We're not agreeing a winner from memory.

beats.text: I've folded my bill like yours. Don't go yet; we need to agree exactly what your starter cost.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I crouched when you crouched, and everyone ran past us. You owe me an apology for that start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was tying my shoe. The starter had already fired.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, checking equipment. You should apologize for giving me the wrong starting signal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't give a signal. I missed the start too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologize for passing your bad start on to me. I could have been running.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I put gold stars on my cake box like you. Now they've disqualified it; apologize for putting mine at a disadvantage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My stars mark boxes that contain nuts. Yours says nut-free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, clear labeling. You should apologize for giving me two ways to label one cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They haven't disqualified it. It's been moved to the nut table for checking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologize for making mine wait while the others are tasted fresh.
